variants.prompt: REFORM MOOD/EXPRESSION: In a dimly lit nightclub, the confident beauty leans against a neon-lit wall, her emerald eyes gleaming with a sultry, predatory intensity. Her full lips are parted slightly, revealing a hint of white teeth, as she looks directly at the camera with a bold, commanding gaze. Her posture is relaxed yet poised, one hand resting on her hip, the other trailing a finger along the wall, as the blurred crowd of dancers spins around her in a whirl of color and movement.
